messages.text: Hi Sarah, Rob L. again. Any words on repairs? It needs to be running right or whats the point?!
Handed to the team · Faulty unit needs an RMA approval. It was flagged Saturday for Monday and he is

No decision on your KBOX yet, Rob, and I'm sorry. You got it on October 29 and you've been reporting this since the 4th. You're right, a unit hashing under 1 TH/s when it's rated for 22 is no use to you.

I've just put it back in front of the team now they're in, with your serial, your readings and your no-overclock answer. They decide on the return and the repair, and nobody will ask you for any of it again.

Stay in this chat and one of them will jump in. If you step away, the answer goes to (email hidden) You can also reach JD on Discord right now: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, mention @nullhashrate.

Ill wait here. You have no idea of the scammers. Or maybe you do. I Want to work so we can properly communicate.  I had the miner off last night. I guess Ill turn it back on, maybe someone will look at it today. They seem to have so many meetings.

Thanks for waiting, Rob. I get it, there are plenty of scammers out there, and you're right to want a straight answer from a real person.

You can keep the miner off. The team already has your readings, photos and serial, so they don't need it running to make the call. Leaving it off also means nothing else can go wrong with it while they look.

The case is in front of them now. I'll stay here with you until one of them joins.
